title: Invoices, meeting minutes and messages that keep trust

say: Invoices, meeting minutes, and messages that keep trust.
This is the video for module 3 of Business Communication.
Money documents are communication too. A vague invoice leads to late payment and arguments. A clear one gets paid faster.
A quotation is your offer, sent before the customer agrees.

cards.d: Before the customer agrees: what we will supply and what it will cost, valid until a date.
After the order is agreed or delivered: please pay this amount, by this date, to this account.
After you are paid: we have received this amount, on this date, for these goods.

say: An invoice asks for payment, after the order is agreed or delivered.

say: A receipt proves you were paid. Write the amount in figures and in words, so no one can easily change it.

say: Ifeoma's first invoice said only: Uniforms, 480,000 naira, pay soon. The school bursar could not tell how many uniforms, or when to pay, so she put it aside.
The new invoice has a number, a date and a due date. Each line shows the item, the quantity and the price. 40 pinafores at 6,500 naira is 260,000. 40 shirt and shorts sets at 5,500 is 220,000.
That is 480,000 naira in total, less the 240,000 deposit already paid.
The balance is 240,000 naira, due within 7 days, with her bank details. Every number adds up, so the bursar can approve it at once.
The day before payment is due, send a friendly reminder with the invoice number, the amount and the date.

panel.heading: Polite, firm payment reminders
items: A few days late: clear, invoice attached
Two weeks late: firm date, or agree a plan

say: If it is a few days late, be clear. Say it was due, ask when payment will be made, and attach the invoice again.

panel.heading: Polite, firm payment reminders
items: A few days late: clear, invoice attached
Two weeks late: firm date, or agree a plan

say: At two weeks late, be firm. Give a date to pay by, or ask them to call today to agree a payment plan.

say: Protect yourself from scams. Fraudsters send fake transfer alerts and fake screenshots. Check your own banking app before releasing goods.
If a supplier suddenly sends new bank details, call them on a number you already have. Never share your OTP, PIN or BVN.

panel.rule: Confirm every payment in your own banking app before releasing goods.

say: Send a short meeting agenda at least a day before, with a time for each item.
Afterwards, write action minutes, not every word. Record the date, time and place, who was present, what was decided, who will do what by when, and the next meeting date.
An action without an owner and a deadline usually does not happen.
For example, Doose is secretary of a women's farming cooperative in Benue. Her first notes said, we talked about the trade fair, we will see. No decision, no owner, no deadline.

panel.heading: Doose's minutes, before and after
right: Take a stand if fee is 60,000 or less

say: Her new minutes record the decision: take a stand if the fee is confirmed at 60,000 naira or less, agreed by 12 of 14 members.
Each action has a name and a date, and the next meeting is set. Share minutes within 48 hours.

say: For example, Blessing sells baked goods in Warri. A customer's birthday cake arrived squashed.
Listen. Blessing reads the whole message, asks for a photo, and does not argue about the delivery rider.
Apologise. I am truly sorry. Your daughter's cake should have arrived perfect.
Solve. She offers a choice: a refund of 12,500 naira of the 25,000 today, or a fresh cake free of charge.
Thank and follow up. She thanks the customer, changes to a sturdier box, and checks in a week later. The customer stays loyal.
A written promise is something the customer plans around. Check your stock, time and cash before you commit.

panel.heading: Honest promises and private data
items: Check stock, time and cash before you promise
Say what you can do, and when
Do not share customers' numbers or chats
Give bad news early, with a new plan

say: Instead of, no problem, 500 packs by Friday, say: we can deliver 300 by Friday and the other 200 by Tuesday.

say: Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023 sets rules for personal data. Collect only what you need, keep it secure, and never post screenshots showing customers' names or numbers.

say: And if a delivery will be late, say so early, with the reason and your new plan. Silence and excuses do far more damage.

say: To remember. A quote is the offer, an invoice asks for payment, a receipt proves it. Number every invoice and show every item.
Check payments yourself. Record decisions with owners and deadlines. And handle complaints with Listen, Apologise, Solve, Thank.

say: Now practise. Create your invoice and receipt templates and save three payment reminders. Write an agenda and action minutes for a real meeting. And prepare your trust toolkit: a data rule, a complaint reply and a bad-news message.
